name: qravate
label: QRavate
description: Dynamic QR codes with style: create QR codes, change their destination without reprinting, pause them, read scan stats.

modules.name: watchQrEvents
modules.label: Watch QR Code Events
modules.description: Triggers when a QR code is created, changed, paused or reaches a number of scans.

modules.name: updateQrCode
modules.label: Update a QR Code
modules.description: Changes the destination or the name of a QR code. The printed QR code stays the same.

modules.name: setQrCodeState
modules.label: Pause or Resume a QR Code
modules.description: Scanners see a neutral page while the QR code is paused.

modules.name: getQrCode
modules.label: Get a QR Code
modules.description: Gets a QR code by ID.

modules.name: searchQrCodes
modules.label: Search QR Codes
modules.description: Lists QR codes, newest first, by name, destination or state.

modules.name: getQrCodeStats
modules.label: Get QR Code Stats
modules.description: Gets the scans of a QR code over a period.
